pairs: Et factum est post mortem Moysi servi Domini,
And after the death of Moses, the servant of the Lord,
ut loqueretur Dominus ad Josue filium Nun,
it happened that the Lord spoke to Joshua, the son of Nun,
et transi Jordanem istum tu, et omnis populus tecum,
and cross this Jordan, you and all the people with you,
in terram quam ego dabo filiis Israël.
into the land which I will give to the sons of Israel.
Omnem locum, quem calcaverit vestigium pedis vestri, vobis tradam,
I will deliver to you every place that the step of your foot will tread upon,
just as I said to Moses.
A deserto et Libano usque ad fluvium magnum Euphraten,
From the desert and from Lebanon, even to the great river Euphrates,
omnis terra Hethæorum usque ad mare magnum contra solis occasum erit terminus vester.
all the land of the Hittites, as far as the great sea opposite the setting of the sun, shall be your border.
Nullus poterit vobis resistere cunctis diebus vitæ tuæ:
No one will be able to resist you during all the days of your life.
Just as I was with Moses,
so will I be with you.
tu enim sorte divides populo huic terram,
For you shall divide by lot,
the land about which I swore to their fathers that I would deliver it to them.
Confortare igitur, et esto robustus valde,
Therefore, be strengthened and be very steadfast,
ut custodias, et facias omnem legem,
so that you may observe and accomplish the entire law,
quam præcepit tibi Moyses servus meus:
which Moses, my servant, instructed to you.
ne declines ab ea ad dexteram vel ad sinistram,
You may not turn aside from it to the right, nor to the left.
So may you understand all that you should do.
Non recedat volumen legis hujus ab ore tuo:
The book of this law shall not depart from your mouth.
sed meditaberis in eo diebus ac noctibus,
Instead, you shall meditate upon it, day and night,
ut custodias et facias omnia quæ scripta sunt in eo:
so that you may observe and do all the things that are written in it.
tunc diriges viam tuam, et intelliges eam.
Then you shall direct your way and understand it.
quoniam tecum est Dominus Deus tuus in omnibus ad quæcumque perrexeris.
For the Lord your God is with you in all things, wherever you may go.”
And Joshua instructed the leaders of the people,
“Cross through the midst of the camp,
quoniam post diem tertium transibitis Jordanem,
For after the third day, you shall cross the Jordan,
et intrabitis ad possidendam terram quam Dominus Deus vester daturus est vobis.
and you shall enter so as to possess the land, which the Lord your God will give to you.’”
he said to the Reubenites and to the Gadites,
and to the one half tribe of Manasseh:
quem præcepit vobis Moyses famulus Domini,
which Moses, the servant of the Lord, instructed to you,
Dominus Deus vester dedit vobis requiem, et omnem terram.
‘The Lord your God has given you rest, and has given you all the land.’
ac jumenta manebunt in terra, quam tradidit vobis Moyses trans Jordanem:
as well as the cattle, shall remain in the land which Moses delivered to you beyond the Jordan.
vos autem transite armati ante fratres vestros,
But as for you, pass over with weapons, before your brothers,
all you who are strong of hand,
donec det Dominus requiem fratribus vestris sicut et vobis dedit,
until the Lord gives rest to your brothers, just as he has given to you,
et possideant ipsi quoque terram quam Dominus Deus vester daturus est eis:
and until they also possess the land, which the Lord your God will give to them.
et sic revertimini in terram possessionis vestræ,
And so shall you be returned to the land of your possession.
And you shall live in the land, which Moses,
quam vobis dedit Moyses famulus Domini trans Jordanem contra solis ortum.
the servant of the Lord, gave to you beyond the Jordan, opposite the rising of the sun.”
“All that you have instructed to us,
And wherever you will send us,
Just as we obeyed Moses in all things,
so shall we obey you also.
tantum sit Dominus Deus tuus tecum,
But may the Lord your God be with you,
just as he was with Moses.
and whoever will not obey all of your words,
which you will instruct to him,
